job_title: Senior Java SpringBoot and Angular Developer
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain web applications using Java SpringBoot and Angular frameworks.
Apply object-oriented principles and design patterns to create scalable system designs.
Develop REST API services and ensure seamless integration with front-end components.
Implement microservices architecture to enhance application modularity and scalability.
Write complex SQL queries and optimize database performance using RDBMS, specifically SQL Server.
Conduct unit testing using frameworks such as Mockito to ensure code quality and reliability.
Independently troubleshoot and resolve application issues, identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions on time and within scope.
requirements: Expert knowledge of Java SpringBoot and Angular with at least 5 years of experience in Java projects.
Proficiency in applying object-oriented principles and recommended design patterns.
Strong experience in developing web applications on the Java platform (Spring, Spring Boot, REST API Services).
In-depth knowledge of RDBMS and experience with SQL Server, including writing complex join queries and SQL query tuning.
Sound knowledge of unit testing methodologies and frameworks (e.g., Mockito).
Ability to independently troubleshoot problems and identify root causes for issues.
other_requirements: Experience with Reactive Programming concepts using Spring WebFlux.
Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms and Docker CI/CD pipelines.
